rule: No branch is deleted in WP-01. Diverged branches are not merged as-is; verified behavior is ported onto current main.

branches.name: main
branches.reason: Authoritative evidence baseline for all new work.

branches.name: agent/selma0-android-native-port-v1
branches.reason: Contains the fuller Kotlin/Compose shell, llama lifecycle, Gradle wrapper, loopback policy, foreground service, and overlay code. Port after Gate 1; do not merge stale workflow or integration assumptions.

branches.name: agent/selma0-android-native-v1
branches.reason: Original native source is preserved by PR #13's newer port branch and remains provenance evidence.

branches.name: agent/selma0-llama-runtime-v1
branches.reason: Contains bounded llama.cpp lifecycle and fake-server tests; port onto the frozen model contract and add real offline evidence.

branches.name: agent/selma0-rag-memory-v1
branches.reason: Contains bounded FTS5/fallback retrieval. Port onto current memory and control-plane contracts with provenance and user controls.

branches.name: codex/selma-android-installable
branches.reason: Introduces a second minimal android shell and does not preserve the current audited runtime architecture. Retain Git history as evidence only.

branches.name: moto-g-play-2023-support
branches.reason: Cleanly based on current main and contains useful rootless install/validation profiles. Port after Gate 1 and re-run physical-device gates.

branches.name: selma0/agent-fabric-v2-20260813
branches.reason: Has no unique changes relative to main.

branches.name: selma-ci-unlock-v1
branches.reason: One obsolete workflow experiment. Retain until the zero-job GitHub Actions startup failure is resolved, then supersede with evidence.

branches.name: selma-command-core-v1
branches.reason: Verified command, permission, audit, replay, and regression content has already been promoted to main through different commit ancestry.

branches.name: selma-data-compiler-v1
branches.reason: Contains provenance/dedup/conflict tooling. Port only after it is constrained to the existing registered-tool control plane.

branches.name: selma-device-crowrf-main-v1
branches.reason: Measured CrowRF/device functionality and tests are already present on main.

branches.name: selma-device-crowrf-v1
branches.reason: Historical combined command/device branch; verified behavior is already represented on main.

branches.name: selma-plugin-adapters-v1
branches.reason: Contains GitHub/plugin adapter concepts and tests. Port later through Gate 1 network/process/device contracts and the existing audit path.
